title: TriMas Packaging Neunkirchen Site Renews ISO Certifications
summary: TriMas Packaging's Neunkirchen, Germany, facility renewed ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISO 50001 certifications and earned a Gold ESG Sustainability Rating.
body_markdown:
## **Facility demonstrates continued excellence in quality, workplace safety and energy management**


TriMas Packaging is pleased to announce that its Neunkirchen, Germany, facility has successfully renewed its **ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISO 50001 certifications** following comprehensive third-party audits.


The successful recertifications reflect the effectiveness of the facility’s management systems and its ongoing commitment to **delivering high-quality products, maintaining a safe workplace, continually improving energy performance and advancing sustainability initiatives** .


- **ISO 9001:2015:** Quality Management Systems
- **ISO 45001:2018** : Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems
- **ISO 50001:2018** : Energy Management Systems


The audits were completed with **no major or minor non-conformities** , underscoring the strength of the facility’s processes, operational controls and employee engagement. In addition, the facility also achieved a **Gold ESG Sustainability Rating Certificate** from independent auditor CISQ / IIIP S.r.l., recognizing its strong performance in environmental, social and governance practices.


> “These certifications demonstrate our commitment to maintaining high standards across our operations while continuously improving the way we serve our customers,” said *Heiner Moeller, Director of Operations, Europe* . “The successful outcome reflects the dedication and collaboration of our team and reinforces our focus on quality, safety, operational excellence and responsible business practices.”


The successful recertifications and Gold ESG Sustainability Rating reinforce Neunkirchen’s reputation as a trusted manufacturing partner and demonstrate TriMas Packaging’s commitment to quality, workplace safety, energy management, sustainability and continuous improvement.
